
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/greywen/p/19800934" title="发布于 2026-03-31 13:45">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">做了个Windows桌面动态网页天气可视化壁纸</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="font-size: 0; line-height: 0; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p" style="margin-top: 0 !important; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 1.5em; margin-left: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">之前做了一个网页天气可视化项目 <a style="color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1); text-decoration-line: none" title="web-weather" href="https://github.com/greywen/web-weather" rel="noopener nofollow">web-weather</a>，用 Canvas 2D + CSS 实现了雨、雪、雾、晴、阴、冰雹、沙尘暴七种天气效果，接了 Open-Meteo 的免费 API 做自动天气，还加了声音系统、世界地图选点、沉浸模式。做完之后我把它挂在副屏上当动态壁纸用了好一阵子——浏览器全屏，切到第二块屏幕，效果确实不错。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">但"浏览器全屏"这个方案有几个很实际的问题：</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• 浏览器窗口始终在最前面，Alt+Tab 会切到它</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• 不小心点到桌面，壁纸就被盖住了</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• 每次开机要手动打开浏览器、输地址、全屏，繁琐</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• 任务栏上多一个浏览器窗口，看着碍眼</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">既然这个网页本身就是为"长期挂着"设计的，为什么不干脆做一个桌面应用，把它真正嵌到 Windows 桌面壁纸层？于是就有了这个项目——<a style="color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1); text-decoration-line: none" title="Weather Wallpaper" href="https://github.com/greywen/weather-wallpaper" rel="noopener nofollow">Weather Wallpaper</a>。&nbsp;<strong>本项目基于 <a href="https://github.com/rocksdanister/lively" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Lively</a> 进行二次开发，聚焦网页天气桌面场景。</strong></p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">在线体验网页版：<a href="https://weather.anhejin.cn" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://weather.anhejin.cn<br></a>演示视频：<a href="https://files.anhejin.cn/videos/demo.mp4" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://files.anhejin.cn/videos/demo.mp4</a></p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><a href="https://files.anhejin.cn/videos/demo.mp4" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"></a></p>
<h2 id="0" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">网页天气可视化做了什么</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">先简单回顾一下网页端的实现。详细的技术细节写过两篇文章：</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <a style="color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1); text-decoration-line: none" title="做了一个网页天气可视化" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/greywen/p/19702808">做了一个网页天气可视化</a></p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <a style="color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1); text-decoration-line: none" title="做了一个网页天气可视化 2" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/greywen/p/19786381">做了一个网页天气可视化 2</a></p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">第一篇主要解决"怎么让天气看起来像那么回事"。Canvas 2D 画粒子——雨滴是上窄下宽的梯形，风力通过 windOffset 让它斜着落；雪花飘落带正弦波摇摆，落到导航栏上会堆积，温度高了会融化；雾天是 Canvas 雾团 + CSS 烟雾纹理 + backdrop-filter 三层叠出来的；晴天有镜头光斑，位置跟太阳成镜像关系；闪电用递归算法做分叉。数据结构用 SoA + Float32Array 做连续内存访问，绘制按透明度分档批量 fill 减少 draw call，雾气纹理预渲染到离屏 Canvas。接了 Open-Meteo 的 API，浏览器定位拿经纬度，WMO 天气代码映射到视觉效果，每十分钟刷新一次。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">第二篇是后续更新。声音系统全面重做——雷声用 Web Audio API 合成了七层（crack、sub-bass boom、re-strike、rolling rumble、延迟重击、远方余震），每层都是独立的音频节点链路，预生成多个变体缓存在内存里，每次打雷听起来都不完全一样。雨声、风声、雪声也不是 MP3 循环，而是多层滤波噪声合成，音量和滤波器频率跟天气参数实时联动。风向还会影响左右声道——风从右边吹，雨声就偏右耳。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">新增了冰雹和沙尘暴两种极端天气。冰雹有加速下落、旋转、落地弹跳碎片、地面碎冰堆积和融化。沙尘暴分三层——350 颗不规则多边形沙粒、5 种手绘碎屑（树枝、树叶、石子、塑料片、泥块）、60 个贴地滚动的沙团——再盖一层全屏沙色蒙版。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">世界地图让你点地球上任意一个点就能看那里的天气，带 24 小时和 7 天预报时间线。沉浸模式把所有 UI 藏起来，全屏只剩天气本身。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">这些东西加在一起，网页端已经是一个可以打开、选地方、听天气、挂一整天的"天气体验器"了。但它始终跑在浏览器里。</p>
<h2 id="1" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">为什么要做桌面应用</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">原因只有一个：我想让它真的变成壁纸。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">不是"看起来像壁纸"，是嵌到桌面图标后面那一层，和 Windows 原生壁纸占同一个位置。桌面图标在上面，网页天气在下面，任务栏正常显示，Alt+Tab 看不到它。开机自动启动，托盘常驻，不占任务栏位置。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">这种需求在动态壁纸领域并不新鲜。Wallpaper Engine 早就做了，Lively Wallpaper 也是开源方案。但我不需要一个通用的动态壁纸引擎——我只需要把一个特定的网页嵌到桌面上。所以我参考了 Lively 的核心思路，用 .NET 9 + WPF + WinForms + WebView2 写了一个极简版本。</p>
<h2 id="2" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">核心原理：WorkerW 窗口层</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">Windows 的桌面壁纸机制其实很有意思。桌面本身是一个叫 Progman（Program Manager）的窗口，桌面图标放在它的子窗口 SHELLDLL_DefView 里的 SysListView32 中。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">要把自己的窗口塞到壁纸层，关键是让 Windows 创建一个 WorkerW 窗口。方法是向 Progman 发送一个未公开的消息 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">0x052C</code>：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace">NativeMethods.SendMessageTimeout(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_progman,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0x052C</span>,<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;new</span>&nbsp;IntPtr(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0xD</span>),<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;new</span>&nbsp;IntPtr(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0x1</span>),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.SendMessageTimeoutFlags.SMTO_NORMAL,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1000</span>,<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;out</span>&nbsp;_);</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">发完之后，Windows 会在 Progman 下面创建一个 WorkerW 窗口。这时候窗口层级变成了：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace" data-language-pending="" data-raw-code="Progman
├── SHELLDLL_DefView (桌面图标)
└── WorkerW (壁纸层)" data-show-line-number="false">Progman<br>├──&nbsp;SHELLDLL_DefView&nbsp;(桌面图标)<br>└──&nbsp;WorkerW&nbsp;(壁纸层)</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">把你的窗口 SetParent 到 WorkerW 里，它就在图标后面了。这就是 Lively 和大多数动态壁纸软件用的方案。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">但 Windows 11 和较新的 Windows 10 有一个区别——Progman 带了 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP</code> 标志，这意味着桌面使用了"raised desktop"模式。这种模式下 WorkerW 是 Progman 的子窗口，需要用不同的策略来 attach：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">if</span>&nbsp;(_isRaisedDesktop)<br>{<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp;设置&nbsp;WS_CHILD&nbsp;样式</span><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;style&nbsp;|=&nbsp;NativeMethods.WS_CHILD;<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp;设置&nbsp;WS_EX_LAYERED&nbsp;并设满不透明度</span><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.SetLayeredWindowAttributes(hwnd,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span>,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;255</span>,&nbsp;NativeMethods.LWA_ALPHA);<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp;父窗口设为&nbsp;Progman</span><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.SetParent(hwnd,&nbsp;_progman);<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp;Z&nbsp;序：壁纸在&nbsp;SHELLDLL_DefView&nbsp;下面</span><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.SetWindowPos(hwnd,&nbsp;_shellDLL_DefView,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span>,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span>,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span>,<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span>,&nbsp;flags);<br>}<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>else</span><br>{<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp;经典模式：直接挂到&nbsp;WorkerW</span><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.SetParent(hwnd,&nbsp;_workerW);<br>}</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">多显示器的情况也要处理。壁纸窗口需要定位到目标显示器的坐标上，reparent 之前用 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">MapWindowPoints</code> 把屏幕坐标转成父窗口内的相对坐标，不然多屏环境下位置会算错。</p>
<h2 id="3" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">WebView2：把网页塞进桌面</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">有了壁纸层，下一步是把网页塞进去。这里用的是 Microsoft 的 WebView2——基于 Chromium 的嵌入式浏览器控件。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">架构上是这样的：一个隐藏的 WinForms 窗口（<code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WallpaperHostForm</code>）里放一个 WebView2 控件，WebView2 加载网页，然后把整个 WinForms 窗口 SetParent 到桌面的 WorkerW 层。</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace">_hostForm&nbsp;=<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;new</span>&nbsp;WallpaperHostForm();<br>_hostForm.Size&nbsp;=<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;new</span>&nbsp;System.Drawing.Size((<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(255, 166, 87, 1)">int</span>)monitor.Bounds.Width,&nbsp;(<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(255, 166, 87, 1)">int</span>)monitor.Bounds.Height);<br>_hostForm.Show();<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br><br>//&nbsp;初始化&nbsp;WebView2</span><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>await</span>&nbsp;InitializeWebView2(audioEnabled);<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><br><br>//&nbsp;把宿主窗口嵌到桌面</span><br>_desktopWorker.SetWallpaper(_hostForm.Handle,&nbsp;monitor.Bounds);</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">WallpaperHostForm 做了几个特殊处理：</p>
<ul class="ul" style="color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em">
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">FormBorderStyle.None</code>：无边框</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">ShowInTaskbar = false</code>：不在任务栏显示</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW</code>：Alt+Tab 里隐藏</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WS_EX_NOACTIVATE</code>：不抢焦点</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">ShowWithoutActivation = true</code>：显示时不激活</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• 初始位置 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">(-32000, -32000)</code>：先放到屏幕外避免闪烁</li>
</ul>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">WebView2 初始化时有一个关键参数——<code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required</code>。网页天气的声音系统依赖 Web Audio API，而浏览器默认的 autoplay policy 要求用户先交互才能播放声音。桌面壁纸没有"用户点一下"这个动作，所以必须绕过这个限制：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">var</span>&nbsp;options&nbsp;=<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;new</span>&nbsp;CoreWebView2EnvironmentOptions(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">"--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required"</span>);<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>var</span>&nbsp;env&nbsp;=<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;await</span>&nbsp;CoreWebView2Environment.CreateAsync(<span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">null</span>,&nbsp;userDataPath,&nbsp;options);<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>await</span>&nbsp;_webView.EnsureCoreWebView2Async(env);</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">同时还关掉了右键菜单、状态栏、缩放控制、新窗口弹出、下载——这些在壁纸场景里都是不需要的。</p>
<h2 id="4" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">鼠标事件转发：让壁纸可以交互</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">壁纸嵌到桌面之后，有一个问题：你点桌面，鼠标消息会被 SHELLDLL_DefView（桌面图标层）吃掉，WebView2 收不到。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">但网页天气是有交互的——世界地图可以点，控制面板可以拖，沉浸模式可以切换。如果壁纸完全不能交互，就少了很多有意思的玩法。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">所以我用了一个全局低级鼠标钩子（<code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WH_MOUSE_LL</code>），在鼠标消息到达任何窗口之前拦截它，判断当前前台窗口是不是桌面（Progman、WorkerW 或 SHELLDLL_DefView），如果是，就把鼠标消息转发给 WebView2：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace">_hookId&nbsp;=&nbsp;NativeMethods.SetWindowsHookEx(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.WH_MOUSE_LL,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_hookProc,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.GetModuleHandle(<span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">null</span>),<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0</span>);</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">转发的时候不能简单地 PostMessage 给 WebView2 的顶层窗口——WebView2 内部有多层子窗口（Chrome 的渲染进程窗口），鼠标消息需要送到最深层的子窗口才能被正确处理。所以用了一个递归查找最深层可见子窗口的方法：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre"><code class="language-csharp" style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">private</span><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;static</span>&nbsp;IntPtr<span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;GetDeepestChild</span>(<span class="hljs-params">IntPtr&nbsp;parent,&nbsp;NativeMethods.POINT&nbsp;screenPt</span>)</span><br>{<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var</span>&nbsp;clientPt&nbsp;=&nbsp;screenPt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NativeMethods.ScreenToClient(parent,<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;ref</span>&nbsp;clientPt);<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var</span>&nbsp;child&nbsp;=&nbsp;NativeMethods.ChildWindowFromPointEx(parent,&nbsp;clientPt,&nbsp;CWP_SKIPINVISIBLE);<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if</span>&nbsp;(child&nbsp;==&nbsp;IntPtr.Zero&nbsp;||&nbsp;child&nbsp;==&nbsp;parent)<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return</span>&nbsp;parent;<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return</span>&nbsp;GetDeepestChild(child,&nbsp;screenPt);<br>}</code></pre>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">目前支持鼠标移动、左键、右键和滚轮。键盘输入没做转发——壁纸场景下基本用不到。</p>
<h2 id="5" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">应用层面的完整度</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">技术原理之外，作为一个"真的会拿来用"的应用，还需要处理很多日常细节：</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">系统托盘</strong>：应用没有主窗口，常驻系统托盘。双击打开设置，右键菜单支持设置、停止、重启和退出。关闭设置窗口只是隐藏，不会退出程序。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">设置持久化</strong>：网页地址、目标显示器、声音开关、开机启动这些配置保存在 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">%LOCALAPPDATA%\WeatherWallpaper\settings.json</code>，启动时自动读取并恢复上次的壁纸。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">多显示器支持</strong>：通过 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">EnumDisplayMonitors</code> 枚举所有显示器，设置界面可以选择把壁纸显示在哪块屏幕上。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">开机启动</strong>：写入注册表 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run</code>，标准的 Windows 启动项方案。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">单实例控制</strong>：用 Mutex 防止重复启动，多开会弹提示。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">默认网页地址就是 <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">https://weather.anhejin.cn</code>——也就是之前做的那个网页天气可视化。打开应用，点"应用壁纸"，桌面就变成了实时天气。它会自动获取你的地理位置，显示你所在城市的当前天气，每十分钟刷新一次。雨天桌面上飘雨，雪天看见雪花堆积，雾天整个桌面朦胧一片，打雷的时候闪电劈下来还有声音。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">当然，因为本质上是嵌入一个网页，所以理论上任何网页都能当壁纸用——只是这个项目本身就是为天气可视化设计的。</p>
<h2 id="6" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">技术栈</h2>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">.NET 9</strong>（<code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">net9.0-windows10.0.18362.0</code>）</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">WPF</strong>：主程序入口和设置窗口</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">WinForms</strong>：WebView2 的宿主窗体（WebView2 的 WinForms 版本更适合做底层窗口嵌入）</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">Microsoft.Web.WebView2</strong>：嵌入式 Chromium 浏览器</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">Win32 API</strong>：WorkerW/Progman 操作、显示器枚举、鼠标钩子、输入转发</p>
<p class="listitem" style="display: block; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-right: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.5em">• <strong class="strong" style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">Newtonsoft.Json</strong>：设置文件读写</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">整个项目代码量不大，核心逻辑集中在三个文件：</p>
<ul class="ul" style="color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em">
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">DesktopWorker.cs</code>：桌面层管理，处理 WorkerW/Progman 窗口层级和 raised desktop 兼容</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">InputForwarder.cs</code>：全局鼠标钩子和消息转发</li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• <code class="codespan" style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">WallpaperEngine.cs</code>：WebView2 初始化、壁纸启停、总调度</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="7" class="h2" style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true">从"做出来"到"用起来"</h2>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">回看整个链路：网页端用 Canvas + CSS + Web Audio API 做出了有雨声有风声有闪电有积雪的天气可视化，桌面端用 WebView2 + Win32 API 把它嵌到了 Windows 壁纸层。两个项目各管各的——网页端只管视觉和声音效果，桌面端只管"怎么把一个网页变成壁纸"。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">这种分层的好处是：网页端可以继续迭代新天气、新效果、新交互，桌面端完全不用改。只要网页更新了，壁纸自动就变了。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">现在我的家里电脑就是这么跑的——Weather Wallpaper 开机自启，副屏一直显示着当前天气。上海下雨的时候桌面也在下雨，晴天的时候有镜头光斑从太阳对侧漂过来。偶尔切到东京看看梅雨季，或者切到迪拜感受 45°C 的酷热。</p>
<p class="p" style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">开源地址：</p>
<ul class="ul" style="color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em">
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• 网页天气可视化：<a href="https://github.com/greywen/web-weather" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/greywen/web-weather</a></li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px">• 桌面壁纸应用：<a href="https://github.com/greywen/weather-wallpaper" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/greywen/weather-wallpaper</a></li>
<li class="listitem" style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><strong>本项目基于 <a href="https://github.com/rocksdanister/lively" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Lively </a>进行二次开发，聚焦网页天气桌面场景。</strong></li>
</ul>

</div>
